blocks.x: IoT, Twin & Robotics for Property & Casualty — sensing, simulating, acting — the operations stack that turns physical assets into self-correcting systems applied to the property & casualty operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it. Both are decision factories — rate against exposure and catastrophe models, settle against policy language and fraud signals — and both reward carriers whose document and data machinery is industrialized.

items: Commercial properties and fleets lack sensor feeds; perils (water, freeze, telematics) are priced blind and prevented worse.
FNOL, estimates, medical and police files arrive as documents; triage takes days and leakage hides in the queue.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Predictive Maintenance & Asset Intelligence, Computer Vision & Edge AI, Computer Vision & Edge AI from the IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics tower, wired into the unit's workflows (FNOL and claims triage, Estimate review and leakage control, Commercial risk surveying) on BI & Analytics Platform and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — Rate filing regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Simulate before you cut steel — plant, fleet and product twins with governed physics and data.
Cameras into instruments — inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.
Fix it before it fails — RUL models wired into planning, spare parts and work orders.
water/freeze/telematics sensors feeding prevention and pricing (peril frequency down on covered sites)
